briefdescription.para: Synthetic documentation entry for the BASECLASS preprocessor macro (no real struct of this name exists).

detaileddescription.para: BASECLASS expands to either : public our_new_delete (when included from C++) or to nothing (when included from C or under SAFEC_EXPORTS), and is interpolated between the struct name and its opening brace in declarations such as struct gmp_CC_struct BASECLASS {...}; further down this header. Doxygen does not expand the macro, so it reads BASECLASS as if it were a struct name and emits this page; the page is an artifact of the macro trick, not a real type.
